description: This class is a Spring component that provides access to reporting process services based on report type. It registers and retrieves services annotated with @ReportService, mapping report types to their corresponding ReportingProcessService implementations.

classes.name: ReportingProcessServiceProvider
classes.description: Provides services to retrieve reporting process services mapped by report type, supporting dynamic registration and lookup.

methods.name: ReportingProcessServiceProvider(List<ReportingProcessService>)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider by registering available ReportingProcessService instances mapped to their report types via annotations.

methods.name: findReportingProcessService
methods.description: Returns the ReportingProcessService associated with the given report type, or null if none is registered.

methods.name: findAllReportingTypes
methods.description: Provides a collection of all registered report types.
